summary: Hardware diagnostic research profile. Candidate features: fader,encoder,button,usb. Software: generic MIDI.
identityNotes: Candidate hardware and software capabilities only; verify manual, revision, HID/MIDI transport, audio I/O, OS support and firmware on a physical unit. No claimed factory tolerances or MIDI identifiers. The exact nanoKONTROL2 Owner's Manual documents USB MIDI IN/OUT. Its Windows XP USB audio device name labels MIDI ports and does not establish audio capability. The 2015-06-01 download-entry date is not firmware; audio capability remains unresolved.
